references.name: login
references.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one fresh high-fidelity buildable desktop UI reference for Spectacles, a personal concert journal. The supplied image is style reference only; create the requested NEW screen, not an edit of the dashboard. Landscape 1536x1024, all essential text large and readable. Same established system: warm ivory #f7f7f2, near-black #1d211e, lime #d5f76a, muted olive #747966, lavender #e9e2f7, thin sage rules #dfe2d9. Refined grotesk type, bold tight-tracked editorial headings 48px, real body text 16px, controls 44-48px tall, clear focus styling, restrained 8px button and 14px photo radii. Reuse Spectacles wordmark with abstract five-bar soundwave. No gradients, no generic rounded card containers, no decorative micro badges, no social login providers, no fake auth claims or verified badge, no browser/device chrome. Four signature motifs: vertical rhythm rules, editorial offset composition, controlled photographic frames, flat product panels. Motion implied subtle float-up and smooth disclosure. All screens explicitly a frontend design preview; passwords not saved or sent. Login screen with no dashboard sidebar. Full desktop split layout: left 50 percent ivory, right 50 percent large inset 24px-margin dark concert photograph in a fixed tall rounded frame, anonymous crowd and bright vertical lime-yellow stage lights, near black edges. Top-left wordmark, small top-right text on ivory 'New here? Create an account'. Left central form max 400px with generous whitespace, small eyebrow 'YOUR PERSONAL ENCORE', headline 'Welcome back.' supporting 'Your next great memory is waiting.' Labels Email and Password, pale outlined inputs 'jamie@example.com' and password dots, eye visibility icon in password input. Dark full-width 'Sign in' button with small lime right arrow. Beneath, fine divider with 'or take a look around', simple full-width outline 'Explore the demo'. Small clear note 'Design preview. Use sample details. Passwords are never sent or saved.' Right photo bottom white large type 'Be there.\nKeep it forever.' and small 'The shows end. The stories stay.' Bottom left 'A personal archive of being there.' No forgotten-password link because no reset backend. Readable 16px fields. Clean small laptop-friendly.
